headline: NVIDIA Rockets 31.48% on Jensen Huang's Return, Setting a Euphoric Tone Before Tuesday's Open
body_html:
NVIDIA is the story ahead of Tuesday's open after its shares jumped 31.48% in Monday's session. Investors welcomed Jensen Huang's return to the chief executive's chair. Coverage described market euphoria, a record burst of options trading in the stock, and relief that the leadership change had eased worries about AI spending.

The move lifted nearly the whole market. The S&P 500 gained 4.71% and the Nasdaq 7.00%, with 604 of the 663 stocks we track rising and 57 falling. Semiconductors averaged a 12.91% gain. Micron rose 19.04%, TSMC 14.08% and Tesla 11.46%. Astera Labs added 23.16% and Credo Technology 22.63%. Apple, up 1.90%, and Broadcom, up 3.00%, trailed the pack.

The session has not opened, so the question at the bell is follow-through. Traders will watch whether buyers stay in control after a one-day surge this size or whether profit-taking sets in, especially among the chip and connectivity names that rallied hardest. Remarks from the Fed's John Williams on rates and oil prices near three-month lows are also in the background.

briefs.headline: Micron Rides the AI Relief Rally
briefs.body: Micron climbed 19.04% on Monday, one of the biggest moves among large companies. Market coverage tied the surge to calmer nerves about AI spending after Nvidia's leadership change. Memory is the area to watch for whether the gains hold at the open.

briefs.headline: TSMC Gains 14.08% as Nvidia Suppliers Cheer
briefs.body: TSMC rose 14.08% as stocks that depend on Nvidia's fortunes rallied together. One commentary piece struck a cautious note, arguing that the shares have historically tended to slip ahead of its sales reports. That makes follow-through a fair test today.

briefs.headline: Options Traders Pile Into Nvidia
briefs.body: Reports say Nvidia set a record for options trading after the chief executive's comeback. Heavy derivatives activity can amplify moves in both directions. After a 31.48% jump, the opening hour may be volatile.

briefs.headline: CrowdStrike Slides 8.92% Against the Tide
briefs.body: CrowdStrike fell 8.92%, the weakest of the day's notable decliners, while 604 stocks in our universe rose. Its chief executive has been publicly defending the Zscaler acquisition as a winning combination. Watch whether the selling continues or eases.

briefs.headline: Fed's Williams Flags Higher Rates Over Time
briefs.body: New York Fed leader John Williams indicated that higher interest rates are likely over time to address inflation. After Monday's big equity rally, that is a counterweight to the optimism. Rate-sensitive sectors such as financials, which averaged a 5.13% gain, are worth watching.

briefs.headline: Oil Near Three-Month Lows; Energy Lags
briefs.body: Crude is reported near three-month lows as growing supply outweighs the Hormuz threat. The energy sector averaged a 1.60% gain on Monday, well behind the market. Baytex Energy fell 3.54%, Texas Pacific Land 3.50% and Chord Energy 3.38%.
